The new Shockwave S5-SS stainless steel suspension base is the latest addition to the S5 product line. Welded construction using electropolished 316 stainless steel to last a lifetime. The Shockwave S5-SS is best suited for salt water environments with high salinity, humidity, and moderate to heavy sea conditions. Fitted with a FOX Rhythm air spring and shock with adjustable rebound and compression, suspension travel is 4-inch vertical and 1.5-inch forward, using a four-link forward action, mitigating deceleration associated with wave impact. 
Features: 
• Designed and manufactured in Canada. 
• Custom tuned and valved marine FOX Rhythm, air spring and shock 
with adjustable rebound and compression. 
• Surge protection: Suspension travel is 4-inch vertical and 1.5-inch 
forward, mitigating deceleration associated with wave impacts. 
• Electropolished Welded 316 Stainless Steel. 
• 4-Link Forward Action. 
• Minimal parts count and simple construction. 
• Easy to mount and adapt to current seating. 
• Best for Professional Mariners use in heavy seas.
